items.title: Episode Review — Cariboo Signals, September 26, 2026
items.content_html:
What the pipeline did, what broke, and what it chose when something broke. Run 36228810949.

Brave API budget exhausted mid-roundup

The body-backfill process hit its 12-call ceiling partway through enriching thin articles. Forty-six degradation warnings all cite the same constraint: remaining articles kept their stub bodies and faced culling as sparse. This is a known tradeoff, but the timing matters. The roundup pool had 38 stories cut by airtime budget already. Thinned articles that couldn't be expanded now compound that loss.

The pipeline proceeded. The final script shipped 3,272 words after one expand pass (first draft was 2,882 against a 3,400 target). What aired reflects the constraint, not the curation.

Citation matching split sharply between segments

The roundup sources resolved well: 12 of 15 citations matched. The deep dive performed worse: 1 of 5 citations matched. Four sources either never surfaced a verifiable link or the link failed validation. The episode ran with that gap.

Territory lookup ceiling reached

A per-run limit of 8 territory checks was hit. Six place names never got checked: South, Lakeside, Mile, House, Likely, and City. These are fragments that might belong to any region or none. The pipeline chose not to guess rather than to block on them.

One story aired out of order

A roundup reordering repair was attempted and partially failed. One story remained in an earlier position than a later block after the fix passed. The episode aired anyway.

R2 sync lost one object

One file referenced by the podcast feed XML was missing from R2 storage and could not be recovered from disk. The episode is live. Crawlers requesting that object will receive a 404.

Runs and timing

The primary run (1:05 AM Pacific) completed in 22 minutes. Both fallbacks ran on schedule: the 2:05 AM fallback finished in 9 seconds, the 3:05 AM fallback is running this review. Script generation consumed 488 seconds. Audio render took 233 seconds. Video upload took 113 seconds.

Anthropic handled 10 API calls on 123,333 input tokens. Brave handled 3 calls. The episode is 20 minutes of audio (18.3 MB) and video (69.9 MB). RSS feed now holds 242 episodes.
